definitions.latency: Device response time per host request in ms. Percentiles use nearest rank.
definitions.latency_change_vs_1x_percent: Compare each policy with its own 1x result on the same trace.
definitions.latency_change_percent: Compare two policies on the same trace and at the same factor.
definitions.zero_interval_pairs: Adjacent requests sharing the same arrival timestamp. Scaling preserves all of them.
